questions.q: Which table stores reusable email templates that a notification record can reference?
options: sysevent_email_action
sysevent_email_template
sysevent_in_email_action
sys_template
questions.explain: sysevent_email_template holds the subject and body content; sysevent_email_action (the notification) points at one via a reference field.

questions.q: Why would five incident-related notifications all reference the same Email Template instead of each writing its own body?
options: Templates are required by the platform and cannot be skipped
So a wording change, like adding a new support phone number, happens in one place instead of five
Notifications cannot have a subject line unless a template is attached
Templates are only cosmetic and have no real effect on maintainability
questions.explain: Reuse means one edit to the shared template updates every notification that references it, instead of editing five near-duplicate bodies and risking drift.

questions.q: A template's body includes ${short_description}. What happens to that text when the notification actually sends?
options: It is sent literally as the text "${short_description}" with no substitution
ServiceNow resolves it against the real record that fired the notification, inserting that record's actual short description
It triggers an Inbound Email Action instead of sending a notification
It is ignored and removed from the final email
questions.explain: Field placeholders written as ${field_name} are resolved at send time against the triggering record, making one generic template produce accurate, record-specific emails.

questions.q: What is the purpose of a template's plain-text fallback body, in addition to the Message HTML field?
options: It replaces the HTML body entirely in all cases
It stores the notification's trigger condition instead of the message
It provides a readable version of the message for email clients or situations where HTML rendering isn't available
It is only used by Inbound Email Actions, never by outbound notifications
questions.explain: Templates support both an HTML body for rich rendering and a plain-text fallback so the message still reads sensibly when HTML isn't rendered.

questions.q: How is an Email Template actually connected to a notification record?
options: Templates attach automatically to every notification on the same table
A reference field on the notification record points to the chosen template
By copying and pasting the template's HTML into the notification's own body field
Templates and notifications cannot be connected; each notification must write its own message
questions.explain: The notification form has a reference field for the template; selecting one means the notification sends exactly that subject and body when its trigger fires.
